basic_info.description: Live at the heart of the Mission in this stylish luxe 3BR, 3-level Townhome - perfect for those who crave sun, culture, and world-class eats. Situated across from the newly renovated Garfield Park, this home offers the ideal blend of modern comfort, walkability, and vibrant neighborhood energy.    The main level is made for entertaining, with an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living space centered around a sleek fireplace - ideal for cozy nights in or hanging out with friends. A sliding door opens to a deeded yard space, perfect for brunching al fresco or grabbing espresso before hitting the town. A powder room adds everyday ease.    Upstairs, two ensuite bedrooms offer flexibility - think guest room, office, or Peloton space. The top-floor primary suite is your personal retreat with a walk-in closet, spa-like bath with soaking tub and double vanity, and a private pano view deck - ideal for enjoying the sunset. A one-car garage seals the deal.    Outside your door? SF's most exciting food scene. Walk to Lazy Bear, Osito, Tartine Manufactory, La Taqueria, and more. With a 99% Walk Score, you'll ditch the car and live local. Tech shuttles, BART, and easy freeway access (280 & 101) make commuting effortless. Mission sun, style, and great dining await.
